selection_audit_reason: Fewer than 170 of 186 transcriptomic dogs could be resolved to COTC021/022 subject IDs from the locked clinical table.
interpretation_guardrails: The original 324-dog randomization does not automatically guarantee exchangeability in the 186-dog RNA subset.
Absence of large measured imbalance cannot rule out selection on unmeasured variables.
Exact blocked-randomization inference must not be claimed until the original randomization strata and RNA-subset selection mechanism are verified.
A 93/93 treatment split inside the RNA subset alone is not evidence that selection was independent of treatment.
